objective.title: Preserve round-metric exact interfaces while repairing Lean 4.33 proof elaboration
objective.statement: Only four proof bodies recorded by check-scope.py may change. Preserve every alias, inclusion derivative, metric tensor/model function, private instance, bundled metric constructor and other proof byte-for-byte. This enables retained-root final verified-upstream endpoint integration; RoundSphereCurvature and sphere metric transport/recognition consumers reuse these actual existing proofs. It does not construct independent core Hamilton inputs or discharge smoothability. No new conditional package, hypothesis, norm or data change.
deliverables: The unchanged interfaces and data compile with exact frozen type/axiom/safety/body guards.
